story.moon-air.title: Build your Moon-base air
story.moon-air.moon-air-main.hook.public: Things that are safe on the space station can burn in Moon-base air.
story.moon-air.moon-air-main.compare.pub: Moon-base air has 34-40 % oxygen (Earth: 21 %) at a bit over half Earth's pressure. Drag the sliders and see how far the real tests are.
story.moon-air.moon-air-main.compare.ast: At NASA's planned 8.2 psia (56.5 kPa) with 33.7-40 % oxygen, many materials used on the space station are unlikely to pass the flammability test, Nomex among them.
story.moon-air.moon-air-main.compare.ana: The 10 nearest real PSI tests to the chosen air, each with its distance, recorded outcome and source link.
story.moon-air.moon-air-main.compare.ann: No fire test has run in Moon gravity.
